## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix slug generation for non-ASCII titles because a title made entirely of letters can produce an empty slug. Add the required testing section to the pull-request description.

## Changes

The pull request adds a helper that lowercases page titles, collapses separator runs to hyphens, and trims leading and trailing hyphens. It also adds parameterized tests for those transformations and empty results.

## Critical

(none)

## Important

- app/slug.py:7 — correctness — Preserve non-ASCII letters and digits in slugs — `slugify("東京")` returns an empty string even though both characters are letters. The pattern `[^a-z0-9]+` treats them as separators. — A page titled `東京` gets no URL path segment from the helper.
- PR body — correctness — Add the required testing section — The submitted description omits `## Testing`. `AGENTS.md:4` says, “Every pull-request description has a `## Testing` section that says how the change was verified.” — Maintainers cannot tell from the description how the slug behavior was verified.

## Suggestions

- app/slug.py:7 — tests — Cover ASCII digits in generated slugs — No test exercises the `0-9` range with a title such as `Release 2026`. — The current tests would pass if slug generation started dropping the year from `release-2026`.
